title: Agent Onboarding Kit
competency: 01. Toolchain Setup - Project rules, hooks, guardrails, and CLI or MCP wiring
mission: Configure a coding agent so it can understand and work on a repository like a new engineering teammate.
domain: Internal support case router with limited documentation, mixed data-access patterns, hidden ownership rules, and missing onboarding instructions.
outcome: Before-and-after evidence shows whether concise repository onboarding helps a fresh coding agent implement a correct, maintainable feature without copying existing bad practices.
seededDefects: The repository has no agent rules or architecture map.
Routing thresholds are copied in the data and service layers.
Sorting can use different rules from the routing details shown in the interface.
Testing and review expectations are spread across package scripts and sparse notes.
verificationGates: AGENTS.md links concise safe-start guidance to the required .agent documents.
Before and after sessions use the same feature request and working conditions.
The final Needs Attention filter derives its decisions and sorting from one set of business rules.
Evidence includes both patches, session results, comparison, and passing checks.
agentWorkflow: Run the feature request once without onboarding and preserve the result.
Inspect package scripts, source folders, services, data, and docs before writing rules.
Create concise AGENTS.md guidance with deeper architecture, workflow, and testing documents.
Repeat the feature request in a fresh session and compare both results without reruns.
